image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution image of a beige audio cassette tape against a blue background. The cassette features two visible spools with dark magnetic tape wound around them. There is a paper label on the top half with stylized text and a handwritten-style strip across the middle. The bottom edge shows the rectangular opening for the tape head and small molded plastic details like screw holes.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the cassette label is nonsensical. The top blue section contains distorted, unreadable pseudo-letters. The middle strip contains repetitive, meaningless character strings ('50g 150g...'). This is a classic AI generation artifact where text structure is mimicked but semantics are absent.
The center hubs of the spools have a slightly smeared, overly smooth plastic texture that lacks the fine mechanical detailing (gear teeth or ridges) usually found on real cassette spools.
The alignment of the bottom screw holes and slots is slightly irregular; they don't appear perfectly symmetrical or aligned with the cassette's horizontal axis, suggesting minor geometric warping.
